issues.message: Source/port at (0.003, 0.003, 0.0015) is within 2 cells (2mm) of the domain edge on the z-axis, just past which the CPML absorber is active. Fields there carry CPML fringe/reflection error; move inward for claims-bearing measurement.

surface_impedance_f0 thin conductor #0: thickness 35µm is below 3 skin depths (151µm at f0 = 1e+10 Hz, delta = 50.33µm). The thick-conductor (Leontovich) surface-resistance model is invalid for thin films — omit surface_impedance_f0 and use the DC sheet path (sigma_bulk*t/d), which is the correct model there.

surface_impedance_f0 thin conductor #0: f0 = 1e+10 Hz is more than 20% away from the source centre frequency 5e+09 Hz. Rs is frozen at f0 with relative band error |sqrt(f/f0)-1| — at the source centre that is 29.3%. Set surface_impedance_f0 to the band centre you actually analyse.
